assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容组织、讨论与返修，官方几何发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry is provisional.

assumptions.statement_zh: 零碳设施涉及的绿地蓝线、文物保护与电网条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory protection and grid conditions are unknown; concept-level only.

assumptions.statement_zh: 碳排放、绿电与能耗数据仅有公开口径，本方案不引用未核实数值，不编造碳排量、绿电比例或发电容量数据。
assumptions.statement_en: No unverified carbon, green-power, or energy figures are cited.

assumptions.statement_zh: 能耗优化与碳普惠均以匿名聚合为边界，不进行个体识别式追踪、不建立大规模行为画像，关键决策人工复核。
assumptions.statement_en: Anonymized aggregation only; no individual-identifying tracking; human review for key decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI生成的零碳科普内容须经人工审核后发布，遵守版权与署名要求，不夸大减碳效果、不把设想写成已确定安排。
assumptions.statement_en: AI-generated green-science copy requires human review; no overstated claims.

assumptions.statement_zh: 绿电直购、绿证与虚拟电厂聚合涉及电力市场政策与电网条件，本方案仅作概念建议，不构成供电或碳减排承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: Green-power purchasing and VPP aggregation are concept-level suggestions; no commitment implied.
